newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hermes stock falls, knocks LVMH.
newsitem.headline: Hermes stock falls, knocks LVMH.

text.p: Shares in Hermes fell sharply on Tuesday on disappointment with its first-half results that also had a knock-on effect on LVMH stock, brokers said.
Hermes shares were down 51 francs, or 4.19 percent, at 1,166 at 1330 GMT, while LVMH shares fell 2.32 percent to 1,139. The bourse's CAC-40 index was 0.09 percent higher at the same time.

Brokers said the market was bothered by the 7.8 percent drop in Hermes's first-half operating profit to 281.6 million francs. SGE Delahaye cut its rating on Hermes to under-perform from neutral and lowered its earnings estimates.
